description: Create a Page (in-product doc / PRD on the spine) and return it (id, title). `body` is plain text — blank-line-separated blocks become paragraphs; omit it for a blank page. title defaults to 'Untitled'. product_id / parent_id (a parent page) are optional and verified in-org.

examples.body:
Problem

Users can't self-serve SAML today.
examples.title: PRD: SSO

body.description: Page content as plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs (optional).

icon.description: An emoji icon for the page (optional).

parent_id.description: Parent page id to nest under, from list_pages (optional).

product_id.description: Product to scope it to, from whoami (optional).

name: create_page
title: Create Page
